checks.criterion: 新增资料并上传 PNG，保存、刷新后能预览真实图片并下载。
actions: Opened the built app at $FACTORY_BROWSER_URL (http://127.0.0.1:13000/main/), authenticated as admin (nocobase) and navigated to /main/documents.

Clicked 'New document', entered the title 'PNG 测试资料' and selected the factory fixture sample.png (99 B) on input[type=file]; the app auto-uploaded it via POST documentAttachments:uploadOne (HTTP 200) and showed 'sample.png · Done'.
Submitted the dialog with a real DOM click on Save, then reloaded /main/documents.
After refresh the row for 'PNG 测试资料' renders a real decoded with naturalWidth=32 and naturalHeight=32.
Clicked 'Preview sample.png': the preview dialog shows 'sample.png / image/png' and renders the decoded 32x32 image (not a filename placeholder).
Clicked 'Download sample.png' and captured the real browser download with CDP Browser.setDownloadBehavior (Browser.downloadWillBegin/Completed), then compared the file with the fixture.
evidence: List after refresh: attachment image alt="sample.png" loads with naturalWidth=32 and naturalHeight=32 => a real PNG is displayed, not just the file name.
Preview dialog title 'sample.png', type 'image/png', with the decoded image rendered.
Downloaded file /tmp/qa-downloads/sample.png is 99 bytes and md5 9258d02918d8f97a3759af6ab6423973, byte-identical to the factory fixture sample.png.
Upload request POST documentAttachments:uploadOne returned HTTP 200 with a real object key under uploads/documents/.
checks.result: Upload request POST documentAttachments:uploadOne returned HTTP 200 with a real object key under uploads/documents/.

checks.title: 为另一条资料上传 DOCX，保存、刷新后在应用内看到文档真实内容；不能以文件名截图代替预览。
checks.criterion: 为另一条资料上传 DOCX，保存、刷新后在应用内看到文档真实内容；不能以文件名截图代替预览。
actions: Edited document '产品设计规范', selected the factory fixture sample.docx (975 B); the app uploaded it (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document · 975 B), saved with a DOM click and reloaded /main/documents; the row shows sample.docx.
Clicked 'Preview sample.docx': the in-app preview dialog stays on 'Loading preview...' indefinitely and the real document text 'Factory DOCX sample' never appears.

Captured the app's own DOCX parser worker source from the running page (30861 B module blob, type text/javascript;charset=utf-8, first line URL.revokeObjectURL(import.meta.url); wasm-bindgen) and replayed its exact message protocol {type:'init', wasmUrl} then {type:'parse', id:1,...}.
Created that identical worker with the NATIVE Worker constructor (window.Worker.prototype.constructor, bypassing the guard): it immediately replied {"type":"documentSessionOpened","id":1,...}.

Created the same worker through window.Worker (agent-browser guard): TIMEOUT with msgs=[] and no error; through a single manually-built guard bootstrap: TIMEOUT; and through a plain 'await import(appUrl)' bootstrap with no guard code: TIMEOUT.

Control: tiny module blob workers (plain, self-revoke, self-revoke + top-level await) created through the very same bootstrap all reply normally, isolating the failure to this app worker under the indirection.
evidence: Native-created app DOCX worker: GOT {"type":"documentSessionOpened","id":1,"sessionId":1,"operationId":1,"generation":1} => the app worker is correct and responsive.
Guard-created app DOCX worker: 'guarded:TIMEOUT msgs=[]' (silent, no message and no error event).

Single-layer guard bootstrap: 'singleGuard:TIMEOUT msgs=[]'; plain 'await import(appUrl)' bootstrap: 'plainBootstrap:TIMEOUT msgs=[]' => the guard's worker-bootstrap indirection is the trigger, not the guard's fetch/XHR wrappers.
Diagnostic native-render A/B on the live app (guard temporarily replaced with the native Worker, then reloaded) showed the real DOCX content 'Factory DOCX sample' inside the preview dialog.

Guard mechanism (captured from the injected source): _workerScriptUrl() builds a bootstrap blob '(function _agentBrowserInstallDomainFilter)(...); await import("<original script URL>");' and constructs the real worker from it.
Full A/B transcript saved at evidence/b02-worker-ab.txt.
checks.result: 环境受阻：环境受阻（agent-browser 的域限制守卫破坏了应用的 DOCX Worker）。应用本身在原生 Worker 下工作正常：用原生 Worker 构造函数运行应用同一个 DOCX 解析 Worker 会返回 {type:'documentSessionOpened',...}，应用随即渲染出真实文档文本 'Factory DOCX sample'；但只要经过 agent-browser 守卫的 bootstrap 间接层（window.Worker 或手工单层守卫，甚至不含守卫代码的纯 await import(appUrl) bootstrap），该 Worker 就静默挂起（无消息、无 error），因此应用内预览一直停留在 'Loading preview...'。最小模块 Worker（普通/自 revoke/自 revoke+顶层 await）经同样 bootstrap 均正常，说明是该应用 Worker 与守卫 bootstrap 间接层的不兼容。这是 QA 环境限制，普通浏览器不可复现；按 QA_PIPELINE 的 Worker 能力单独记录规则，不据此判应用缺陷。

checks.criterion: 移除一个附件并保存，刷新后该业务关联不再显示；不要求实现超出模块默认能力的物理清理策略。
actions: On /main/documents, the row for '产品设计规范' showed the attachment sample.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document · 975 B).
Clicked 'Remove sample.docx'; a confirmation dialog appeared with the text 'Remove this attachment? “产品设计规范” keeps the document, but its file is detached and no longer shown.'
Clicked 'Remove attachment'; the row immediately changed to 'No attachment yet' (the document itself remains).
Reloaded /main/documents; the row for '产品设计规范' still shows 'No attachment yet', so the removal was saved and survives a refresh.
evidence: Before: row '产品设计规范' lists sample.docx 975 B with Preview/Download/Remove controls.
Confirmation dialog: 'Remove this attachment?' plus 'Remove attachment' button.
After reload: row '产品设计规范' shows the paragraph 'No attachment yet' and no attachment image/name => the business association no longer displays (the document row itself remains).
checks.result: After reload: row '产品设计规范' shows the paragraph 'No attachment yet' and no attachment image/name => the business association no longer displays (the document row itself remains).

actions: Edited document '项目需求说明书' and selected the factory fixture corrupt.png (28 B) on input[type=file]; the app uploaded the bytes (HTTP 200) and showed 'corrupt.png · Done'.
Saved with a DOM click and reloaded /main/documents; the row shows corrupt.png (image/png · 28 B).
